prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit and sprite-sheet expansion. Reference image shows the EXISTING GEPETO chibi robot boss from a rhythm game. Preserve recognisable round black glass face visor, white/silver segmented helmet with round side earpods, stocky mechanical body, white plated arms, big black gauntlets and heavy short boots, polished 3D sprite style. Improve him without replacing the original robot.
Output production PNG exactly 1024x1536 pixels, EIGHT columns by TWELVE rows, 96 square 128x128 cells. Recompose the reference into this new 8x12 action grid. Fixed front-three-quarter camera, same 95px-tall body and feet baseline in each cell, full character and effects inside 8px safe gutters. Fully transparent alpha ZERO background, no floor shadows, no gradient backdrop, no text, labels or grid.
NORMAL identity: friendly but confident cyan/teal vertical digital eyes on black glass visor, original white/silver armor and black joints, teal seam lights. Replace the generic chest circuit mark with a clearly recognisable CHATGPT/OPENAI SIX-FOLD INTERWOVEN KNOT logo, white-teal interlocking loop emblem on dark round green chest panel. Small matching knot emblem on helmet forehead plate, no company words. Original proportions unchanged.
EVIL PHASE TWO: significantly more menacing CORRUPTED GEPETO, still cute chibi, cartoon mechanical villain, no gore. White helmet plates physically split and rise into TWO swept-back pointed black/red metal HORNS. Visor glass CRACKS with red-lit fractures, eyes become sharp slanted glowing red triangles and a small jagged red DIGITAL GRIN appears. Shoulder panels hinge outward into prominent sharp triangular red-black fins, three gauntlet fingers extend into little metal claws. Armor becomes slightly separated floating angular plates with dark crimson energy leaking from seams. Chest six-loop ChatGPT knot emblem remains recognisable but broken with red corruption lines. Split helmet horns, sharp shoulders, claws, cracked glass and digital grin in ALL evil frames. Must visibly change geometry and silhouette, NOT just color. Stylish spooky and playful collectible robot villain, moderate horror, no organic teeth, no blood, not realistic horror.
Animation rows top-to-bottom, 8 incremental frames left-to-right:
1 NORMAL idle breathing/blinking, knot emblem readable.
2 NORMAL hurt recoil/recover.
3 TRANSFORMATION 8-frame progressive sequence: 1 original normal, 2 chest flickers, 3 visor cracks and eyes narrow, 4 helmet plates start lifting, 5 horns extend, 6 shoulders unfold and claws extend, 7 jagged grin lights up, 8 complete evil stance.
4 EVIL idle with horns, sharp shoulders, cracked red visor, digital grin.
5 EVIL hurt/recover; never remove horns or grin.
6 NORMAL prepare, gather compact cyan energy orb with hands, last two frames charged.
7 NORMAL attack, thrust hand to launch cyan orb then recover.
8 NORMAL blocked, orb shatters into blue pixels, surprised face, recover.
9 EVIL prepare, claw hands gather red-black electric orb.
10 EVIL attack, launch jagged red orb then recover.
11 EVIL blocked red fragments, angry face, recover.
12 EVIL defeat stagger, kneel, horns collapse, lights fade, robot dissolves to scattered red pixels by last frame.
Keep original reference character identity in normal rows. Every EVIL sprite throughout rows4,5,9,10,11 has same distinctive permanent horns and grin and claw/shoulder silhouette. Real alpha background with zero-opacity gutters. Exact 2:3 1024x1536 image, uniform 8x12 grid.
